entities.name: Hailin
entities.description: A man from the village of Lambholt on Innistrad, husband of archmage Vadrik, who loves strange rhymes and songs.

entities.name: Lambholt
entities.description: Small farming village where Hailin was born and raised.

entities.name: Old Stickfingers
entities.description: Creature behind the murders in Lambholt, subject of a nursery rhyme.

events.summary: Hailin encourages Vadrik to take on the Lambholt mission to clear his head.
